data.name: Evelyn
data.gender_notes: Evelyn is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old French aveline, 'hazelnut', or from Eve + the diminutive suffix. Its root is Old French aveline. A Christian name used across Europe. Evelyn is a English name meaning “Hazelnut; (also) desired”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Evelyn expresses “Hazelnut; (also) desired”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Old French aveline, 'hazelnut', or from Eve + the diminutive suffix.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Evelyn total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
